questions.q: 433. The instrument used to reproduce plans to a different scale is called:
questions.explain: A pentagraph (or pantograph) is the specific mechanical device used to enlarge or reduce maps and plans to a different scale.

questions.q: 434. The instrument used for measuring area on a contour map is:
questions.explain: A planimeter is the standard instrument used to calculate the area of any irregular shape, such as a catchment area on a contour map.
